hints.title: Use one queen per row
hints.body: Any valid placement must put exactly one queen in each row. Deciding the column for row after row removes row conflicts automatically.

hints.title: Track the attacked lines
hints.body: Besides used columns, track both diagonal directions. Two squares share a top-left-to-bottom-right diagonal when `row - col` is equal, and share the other diagonal when `row + col` is equal.

hints.title: Count instead of storing
hints.body: You do not need to build the board. When the row index reaches `n`, add one to the answer. A bitmask can track all forbidden columns and diagonals compactly.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
count(row, columns, diag_down, diag_up):
    if row == n:
        return 1

    total = 0
    for col from 0 to n - 1:
        if col is used or (row - col) is used or (row + col) is used:
            continue
        total += count(row + 1,
                       columns with col,
                       diag_down with row - col,
                       diag_up with row + col)
    return total

return count(0, empty, empty, empty)
```
